meta.dateWindow: all-time (CV /character/ endpoint; cover_date filter not supported on /issues/)
meta.note: modernSharedComics = issues in which both characters appear, from the CV character endpoint. For characters who debuted after 2003 all appearances are modern; pre-2003 characters may include some classic-era issues. Only characters in cv-ids.json with a confirmed non-null ID are included. Run build-modern-comicvine.js to regenerate.
